    Ask A Gator

    Join us for a virtual information session!

    The University of Florida Office of Admissions virtual information sessions give students and their family members a chance to learn more about our community and the opportunities that make UF a great college experience at an affordable price. The sessions feature an Admissions Officer providing information about the University of Florida and the application process, while hearing from current students about their experience as a Gator! Have a chance to ask your questions during the live Q&A following a presentation and panel.

    If you have any questions, contact our office by phone at 352-392-1365 or by filling out the form at admissions.ufl.edu/contact.
